brief: Our current median delivery cycle is 8 weeks. Without a change, we expect it to reach 10 weeks next quarter. We want to reduce it by at least 15% relative to today's 8-week level by the end of that quarter. We are considering test automation or a release coordinator. Automation may initially slow delivery; the coordinator could help but hiring time is uncertain. We must not worsen the current defect rate. Help us understand the causal trade-offs.
